info.title: Banking API Specification
info.description: The Banking API enables secure management of financial accounts, transactions, and customer profiles, offering robust functionalities for modern banking services. It adheres to PCI-DSS, PSD2/Open Banking, and KYC/AML compliance standards.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Operations related to customer bank accounts.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Customer profile management and KYC processes.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of customer accounts
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all bank accounts associated with the authenticated customer. Supports filtering by account type and status.

parameters.name: accountType
parameters.description: Filter accounts by type (e.g., 'SAVINGS', 'CHECKING').

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter accounts by their current status (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'CLOSED').

post.description: Creates a new bank account for the authenticated customer. Requires specifying the account type and initial currency. The account will be in a PENDING state until internal verification is complete.

requestBody.description: Details for the new account to be created.

value.message: Account created successfully. Status is PENDING.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a single bank account identified by its unique `accountRef`. The authenticated user must own or have explicit access to this account.

parameters.name: accountRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the bank account.

patch.description: Updates the status of a specific bank account. This can be used to freeze, unfreeze, or close an account. Only allowed for authorized personnel or specific customer-initiated actions.

parameters.name: accountRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the bank account.

get.summary: Retrieve transactions for a specific account
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of transactions associated with a given bank account. Supports filtering by transaction type, status, and date range.

parameters.name: accountRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the bank account.

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: Filter transactions by type (e.g., 'DEBIT', 'CREDIT', 'TRANSFER').

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter transactions by their current status (e.g., 'COMPLETED', 'PENDING', 'FAILED').

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for filtering transactions (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2023-01-01').

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for filtering transactions (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2023-12-31').

200.description: Successfully retrieved list of transactions for the account.

get.summary: Retrieve all transactions for the authenticated customer
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all transactions associated with the authenticated customer across all their accounts. Supports filtering by transaction type, status, and date range.

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: Filter transactions by type (e.g., 'DEBIT', 'CREDIT', 'TRANSFER').

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter transactions by their current status (e.g., 'COMPLETED', 'PENDING', 'FAILED').

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for filtering transactions (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2023-01-01').

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for filtering transactions (ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2023-12-31').

200.description: Successfully retrieved list of all customer transactions.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for a single transaction identified by its unique `transactionId`. The authenticated user must be involved in or have explicit access to this transaction.

parameters.name: transactionId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the transaction.

post.description: Initiates a new payment from a source account to a destination account. This endpoint supports Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) as per PSD2 requirements. An `Idempotency-Key` header is required to prevent duplicate submissions.

requestBody.description: Details for the payment to be initiated.

201.description: Payment initiation successful. May require SCA.

get.description: Retrieves the profile details for a specific customer. The authenticated user must be the customer themselves or an authorized agent.

parameters.name: customerRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

post.description: Registers a new customer in the banking system. This initiates the KYC process, and the customer's `kycStatus` will initially be 'PENDING'.

requestBody.description: Details for the new customer to be created.

201.description: Customer profile created successfully, KYC initiated.

value.message: Customer created. KYC verification is pending.

post.summary: Submit KYC documents for a customer
post.description: Submits identity verification documents for a customer to update their KYC status. This is a critical step for compliance.

parameters.name: customerRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

requestBody.description: KYC document details and base64 encoded image.

200.description: KYC documents submitted successfully. Status updated to PENDING_REVIEW.

value.message: KYC documents submitted. Status is PENDING_REVIEW.

get.description: Retrieves the current Know Your Customer (KYC) verification status for a specific customer.

parameters.name: customerRef
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of customer cards
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all payment cards (debit, credit, prepaid) associated with the authenticated customer.

parameters.name: cardType
parameters.description: Filter cards by type (e.g., 'DEBIT', 'CREDIT').

parameters.name: statusCode
parameters.description: Filter cards by their current status (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'BLOCKED', 'EXPIRED').

post.description: Issues a new payment card (debit or credit) for the authenticated customer, linked to a specified account. The card will typically be in a 'PENDING_ACTIVATION' state.

requestBody.description: Details for the new card to be issued.

post.description: Blocks a payment card, preventing any further transactions. This is typically used in cases of loss, theft, or suspected fraud.

parameters.name: cardId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the card to be blocked.

post.description: Unblocks a previously blocked payment card, allowing transactions to resume. This action may require additional verification.

parameters.name: cardId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the card to be unblocked.

reason.description: The reason for unblocking the card.

post.summary: Create a new data sharing consent (PSD2/Open Banking)
post.description: Allows a customer to grant consent for third-party providers (TPPs) to access specific data or initiate actions on their behalf, in compliance with PSD2/Open Banking regulations.

requestBody.description: Details for the new consent to be created.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific data sharing consent, including granted scopes and expiry date.

parameters.name: consentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the consent.

delete.description: Revokes an existing data sharing consent, immediately terminating access for the associated third-party provider.

parameters.name: consentId
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the consent to be revoked.

204.description: Consent revoked successfully. No content returned.

idempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
idempotencyKeyHeader.description: A unique key that identifies an idempotent request. This key ensures that if a request is sent multiple times, the operation is performed only once. It should be a UUID.

paginationCursor.name: cursor
paginationCursor.description: A cursor for pagination, typically the ID of the last item from the previous page. Used for cursor-based pagination instead of offset.

paginationLimit.name: limit
paginationLimit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

paginationOffset.name: offset
paginationOffset.description: Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.
